item.title: A Shared ChatGPT Link Could Run Attacker Code in Your Session and Read Private Chats
item.description: A malicious ChatGPT share link could run an attacker's code in the logged-in session of anyone who opened it, allowing them to read their private conversations, researchers at the security firm Parameter showed. The researchers reported the flaw through OpenAI's bug bounty program on October 18, and OpenAI fixed it eight days later and rated it P1, its most serious category.

item.title: Cloudflare Reports 18.2 Million Network-Layer DDoS Attacks in Q3, Up 38%
item.description: Threat actors are launching about 8,226 network-layer distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) attacks per hour, Cloudflare revealed Thursday. The web infrastructure and security company said it autonomously mitigated 18.2 million network-layer (L3) DDoS attacks and 14.4 trillion HTTP DDoS requests in the third quarter of 2026. item.description: TeamViewer has fixed a flaw that lets the machine being controlled in a remote session attack the computer that connected to control it.
